verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is software you install and run on your own machines. The official docs cover Ubuntu deb installs (ROS-Base bare-bones and Desktop variants) with a verification step for the C++ and Python APIs, and the source is public on GitHub. A community member also describes it as open source that anyone can improve. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party license or openness statement, documented source-build or non-Ubuntu self-hosting paths, and a production-grade deployment path (one long-time user notes the Open Robotics debs aren't suitable for most product deployments).
